Here is a transcription of the historical marriage register entries visible in **image_565867.png**.

The register pages are divided into two columns under the year headings. The entries are primarily written in Latin, which was standard for Catholic parish records of this era.

---

## Left Page (1860)

* **March 26.** Susannam Talty & Michael Keafan(?) [Witnesses:] Maria M[^c]Namara de Antrim(?) [Witnesses:] Patritio Keafan & Maria Reilly. *James O'Toole P.P.*
* **April 14.** Michaelem O'Donohue et Carolinam Groither e secta Protestantium in gremio Roman ecclesia primum super receptam cum auctoritate et licentia Episcopi matr: junxi coram Maria Donohue et Maria Donahue. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **[April] 25.** Johannem Connell et Mariam Costello matrimonio junxi de Crome coram Thoma Shea, Maria Mason. *James O'Toole P.P.*
* **May 25.** Johannem Molony & Johannem Meylan matrimonio junxi coram Johanne Molony & Johanna Punch. *J. O'Toole P.P.*
* **June 24.** Michaelen Twomey & Brigittam Bowden cum licentia Parochi matr: junxi coram David Flannery & Margareta Higgins. *James O'Toole P.P.*
* **Julii 24.** Patritium Leary et Mariam Moloney cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Brigida Reinnin(?) et Joanna Danaher. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **[Julii] 22.** Johannem M[^c]Namara & Hannam Hellion cum licentia Parochi matr: junxi coram Michaele M[^c]Namara & Marg[^t] Allion. *James O'Toole P.P.*
* **[Julii] 25.** Joannem M[^c]Guire et Ellenam Riordan cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Daniele Foley et Catharina O'Donnell. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **[Julii] 29.** Johannem Geary & Anna Sellars cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Simone Sellors et Maria Danaher. *Jacobus Roche P.P.*
* **Augt. 5.** Patritium Hanly et Mariam Hayes cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Joanne Murray et Brigida Grady. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **[Augt.] 15.** Jacobum Mackey et Margaritam Hogan cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Patritio Hogan & Jania Doan(?). *Joannes Hayes V.G.*

## Right Page (1860)

* **Augt. 19.** Johannem Boyle & Cath[^m] Flynn matr: junxi cum licentia Parochi coram Michael Hayes & Maria Cowley. *James O'Toole P.P.*
* **7ber [Sept] 8.** Michaelem Fitzgerald et Honoram Hogan cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Maria O'Meara et Ellena Cagney. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **[Sept] 23.** Gulielmus Condon et Mariam Wallace cum Parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Dionisio Begley et Johanna Wallace. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **October 14th.** Dionisium Meyers & Margaritam Lyons Cum licentia Parochi matr: junxi coram Dionisio Knight & Brig[^t] Sullivan. *Jacobus Roche P.P.*
* **11ber [Nov] 4.** Jacobum Dinan(?) et Annam Moriarty de Croom cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Thoma & Maria Roche. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **[Nov] 25.** Thomam Shea et Mariam Blake cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Joanne Shea et Maria Donahoe. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **[Nov] 28.** Michaelem Quilty et Brigidam M[^c]Namara de Foureen(?) cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Thoma M[^c]Namara et Catritio(?) Mulcahy. *Joannes Hayes V.G.*
* **Xber [Dec] 10.** Thomam Cooney & Catharinam Sheehan de Lodomork(?) cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Cornelio Sheehan & Maria Curran. *James O'Toole P.P.*
* **[Dec] 17.** Patritium Rahm(?) & Ellenam Prisell de Dalles(?) cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Patritio Russell et Judith Griffin. *Jacobus Roche P.P.*
* **[Dec] 24.** Gulielmum Connor et Mariam Hogan cum parochi licentia matr: junxi coram Maria Donahue & Maria Twoly(?). *Joannes Hayes V.G.*

---

### Key/Abbreviations:

* **matr: junxi / matrimonio junxi:** "Joined in marriage"
* **coram:** "In the presence of" (preceding the witnesses)
* **cum parochi licentia:** "With the parish priest's permission"
* **7ber, 8ber, 9ber, 10ber:** Standard Latin abbreviations for September, October, November, and December.
* **P.P. / V.G.:** Parish Priest / Vicar General
